tools.name: beehiiv_list_publications
tools.description: List the publications this API key can access. Use it first to find a publication id. beehiiv API: GET /v2/publications.

tools.name: beehiiv_get_publication
tools.description: Get one publication: name, description, time zone, reply-to address and double opt-in setting. beehiiv API: GET /v2/publications/{publicationId}.

tools.name: beehiiv_list_subscriptions
tools.description: List subscribers of a publication with status, tier, tags and optional stats. Filter by status or tier, or by exact email. Use cursor for the next page. beehiiv API: GET /v2/publications/{publicationId}/subscriptions.

tools.name: beehiiv_get_subscription
tools.description: Get one subscriber by id: status, tier, tags, custom fields and newsletter lists. beehiiv API: GET /v2/publications/{publicationId}/subscriptions/{subscriptionId}.

tools.name: beehiiv_get_subscription_by_email
tools.description: Find one subscriber by email address. beehiiv API: GET /v2/publications/{publicationId}/subscriptions/by_email/{email}.

tools.name: beehiiv_list_posts
tools.description: List posts (newsletter issues) of a publication. Filter by status (draft, confirmed, archived) or audience. beehiiv API: GET /v2/publications/{publicationId}/posts.

tools.name: beehiiv_get_post
tools.description: Get one post by id: title, subtitle, status, publish date, audience and web/email settings. beehiiv API: GET /v2/publications/{publicationId}/posts/{postId}.

tools.name: beehiiv_list_automations
tools.description: List automations (email sequences) of a publication with their status. beehiiv API: GET /v2/publications/{publicationId}/automations.

tools.name: beehiiv_get_automation
tools.description: Get one automation by id. beehiiv API: GET /v2/publications/{publicationId}/automations/{automationId}.

tools.name: beehiiv_list_segments
tools.description: List audience segments of a publication with their status and subscriber counts. beehiiv API: GET /v2/publications/{publicationId}/segments.

tools.name: beehiiv_get_segment
tools.description: Get one segment by id: its filter definition and status. beehiiv API: GET /v2/publications/{publicationId}/segments/{segmentId}.

tools.name: beehiiv_list_custom_fields
tools.description: List the custom subscriber fields defined on a publication. beehiiv API: GET /v2/publications/{publicationId}/custom_fields.

tools.name: beehiiv_list_tiers
tools.description: List the premium tiers (paid subscription levels) of a publication. beehiiv API: GET /v2/publications/{publicationId}/tiers.

tools.name: beehiiv_list_newsletter_lists
tools.description: List the newsletter lists (sub-audiences a subscriber can join) of a publication. beehiiv API: GET /v2/publications/{publicationId}/newsletter_lists.

tools.name: beehiiv_list_webhooks
tools.description: List the webhook endpoints registered on a publication. beehiiv API: GET /v2/publications/{publicationId}/webhooks.

tools.name: beehiiv_list_polls
tools.description: List polls of a publication, optionally for one post. beehiiv API: GET /v2/publications/{publicationId}/polls.

tools.name: beehiiv_get_referral_program
tools.description: Get the referral program settings of a publication (reward tiers and whether it is on). beehiiv API: GET /v2/publications/{publicationId}/referral_program.

tools.name: beehiiv_create_subscription
tools.description: Add an email address as a subscriber of a publication. Only add people who asked to join. Set reactivate_existing only when the person consented again. beehiiv API: POST /v2/publications/{publicationId}/subscriptions.

tools.name: beehiiv_update_subscription
tools.description: Change a subscriber's tier, newsletter lists, or unsubscribe them from the publication. Send only the fields to change. beehiiv API: PUT /v2/publications/{publicationId}/subscriptions/{subscriptionId}.

tools.name: beehiiv_add_subscription_tags
tools.description: Add tags to one subscriber. Tags group subscribers; they do not send anything. beehiiv API: POST /v2/publications/{publicationId}/subscriptions/{subscriptionId}/tags.

tools.name: beehiiv_remove_subscription_tags
tools.description: Remove tags from one subscriber. The tag stays on the publication. beehiiv API: DELETE /v2/publications/{publicationId}/subscriptions/{subscriptionId}/tags.

tools.name: beehiiv_create_draft_post
tools.description: Create a draft post (newsletter issue) from HTML. The post is saved as a draft only: it is not scheduled or sent. Review it in beehiiv before you publish. beehiiv API: POST /v2/publications/{publicationId}/posts.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: beehiiv_list_subscriptions, beehiiv_get_subscription_by_email, beehiiv_list_posts, beehiiv_get_post, beehiiv_list_automations, beehiiv_list_polls · Private data: beehiiv_list_publications · Public sink: beehiiv_list_subscriptions, beehiiv_get_subscription_by_email, beehiiv_get_post, beehiiv_list_automations, beehiiv_list_webhooks, beehiiv_list_polls, beehiiv_create_subscription, beehiiv_update_subscription, beehiiv_add_subscription_tags, beehiiv_create_draft_post · Destructive: beehiiv_remove_subscription_tags.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: beehiiv_list_subscriptions, beehiiv_get_subscription_by_email, beehiiv_list_posts, beehiiv_get_post, beehiiv_list_automations, beehiiv_list_polls · Private data: beehiiv_list_publications · Public sink: beehiiv_list_subscriptions, beehiiv_get_subscription_by_email, beehiiv_get_post, beehiiv_list_automations, beehiiv_list_webhooks, beehiiv_list_polls, beehiiv_create_subscription, beehiiv_update_subscription, beehiiv_add_subscription_tags, beehiiv_create_draft_post · Destructive: beehiiv_remove_subscription_tags

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
